sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((COALESCE((p.traits @> $3::jsonb), false) AND COALESCE((p.traits @> $4::jsonb), false) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((NOT (jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) <> 'null')), false)))
